revised_scope.project_title: DirectoryHub - Advanced Search & Member Experience Overhaul
revised_scope.project_objective: Deliver a high-performance, conversion-optimized directory portal for Alex Rivers (DirectoryHub).
revised_scope.current_problem: Current platform lacks distance radius filtering, causing visitor drop-off and irrelevant search results. Mobile user experience requires optimization, and key commercial checkout and lead export workflows require automated integration to prevent manual administrative overhead.

agreed_requirements.description: Distance and radius-based filtering by zip code and user geolocation (5, 10, 25 miles).
agreed_requirements.source_passage: We desperately need distance and zip code radius search so visitors can specify 5, 10, or 25 miles.
agreed_requirements.speaker: Alex Rivers
agreed_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Visitors can input a zip code or enable location to see members within selected radius.

agreed_requirements.description: Interactive Google Maps display on search results page with geocoded member pins.
agreed_requirements.source_passage: We also want an interactive map display on the search results page alongside the member cards so users can see pins on the map.
agreed_requirements.speaker: Alex Rivers
agreed_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Search results render a dynamic map with pins corresponding to matched member listings.

agreed_requirements.description: Enhanced member search cards with photos, verified badges, star ratings, and category labels.
agreed_requirements.source_passage: On the search cards, we need member profile photos, verified badges, star rating reviews, and their primary service categories.
agreed_requirements.speaker: Alex Rivers
agreed_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Search cards display member headshots, review ratings, categories, and verified badges.

agreed_requirements.description: Member phone number privacy protection (hidden from anonymous public visitors).
agreed_requirements.source_passage: We want member phone numbers hidden from anonymous visitors. Only logged-in registered members should be able to see their direct phone number.
agreed_requirements.speaker: Alex Rivers
agreed_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Anonymous users see 'Login to View Phone'; logged-in users see direct phone number.

agreed_requirements.description: Mobile web responsive performance optimization and homepage hero banner update.
agreed_requirements.source_passage: Over 65% of our traffic is on smartphones... sluggish on mobile... need fast mobile performance and updated homepage banner.
agreed_requirements.speaker: Alex Rivers
agreed_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Mobile page load under 2.5s; hero banner uploaded in 1920x600 WebP format.

agreed_requirements.description: AI-powered natural language conversational search query parser.
agreed_requirements.source_passage: Visitors should be able to type 'find emergency 24/7 commercial plumbers near downtown with at least 4.5 star ratings' and have an LLM parse the intent.
agreed_requirements.speaker: Alex Rivers
agreed_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Natural language search input parsed via LLM into structured filter parameters.

agreed_requirements.description: Custom Google Maps polygon boundary drawing filter.
agreed_requirements.source_passage: We also want to add interactive custom polygon boundary drawing on the Google Map so users can hand-draw custom search shapes.
agreed_requirements.speaker: Alex Rivers
agreed_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Users can draw custom polygon vectors on map to filter search results within drawn boundaries.

revised_scope.proposed_solution: Implement a cohesive, hybrid solution leveraging Brilliant Directories native configuration for core settings (Google Maps radius, payment gateways, review moderation) and dedicated custom modules where out-of-the-box settings are insufficient, ensuring optimal budget allocation and fast delivery.
